target.statement: Frozen db2 level-3 32-bit wavelet MAV + k-means pipeline achieves 84.26% accuracy on the held-out test set of 2,001 integers (0–10,000).

compute.basis: The pipeline is a level-3 db2 DWT on 32-bit vectors plus 1-D k-means (k=2) on 10,001 integers; all operations are trivial on CPU and the tagged repo includes frozen splits and scripts.

title: Wavelet-Based Parity Detection Revisited: Representation Dependence, Generalization, and Mechanistic Analysis
